title: Eleven more ways to find Pollinations in the wild
summary:
A community harvest: eleven new apps, sturdier generation routes, and API tooling that reveals more while guessing less.

The community directory grew across chat, image, writing, Android, desktop, and no-code workflows: from Batch Imagine and jewelry rendering to bilingual story tools, cat stickers, receipt tarot, and a visual agent-automation builder. The app garden is becoming usefully strange.

MCP agents can now inspect available account Quests with the new read-only listQuests tool, while filtered per-key and per-model usage queries work again. API-key validation, permissions, metadata, delegated tokens, and account access are also now handled consistently across the platform.

Flux fallback routing now goes through the shared registry for more resilient image generation; Trellis reports invalid image inputs as useful 400s; and Azure reasoning models quietly ignore sampling fields they do not support. Myceli requests also have room to finish, with a five-minute proxy timeout.
